Class Player

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.player.Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents a single player in the game, identified by a unique nickname and a totem color.

A player's entire mutable state – resources, acquired characters and buildings, prestige points and the various bonuses granted by card effects – is held in their Tribe. The Player class acts mainly as a façade over the tribe, exposing its data and operations to the rest of the model (most notably to the card strategies), so that callers never have to chain through getTribe() directly.

    • payFood

      public void payFood(int food, int ppPerFood)
      Makes the player pay an amount of food, converting any shortfall into a prestige point loss.

      Delegates to Tribe.payFood(int, int): if the tribe does not hold enough food, the missing units are paid in prestige points instead, at a rate of ppPerFood points per unit.

      Parameters:
      food - the amount of food to pay (must be positive)
      ppPerFood - the prestige points lost for each unit of food that cannot be paid (must be positive)

      public static Player fromSnapshot(PlayerSnapshot snapshot, Map<String,Card> cardMap)
